description: The bar chart illustrates the number of sentences (in thousands) across various categories, with the vertical axis labeled "Sentences (K)" ranging from 0 to 800 in increments of 200. The horizontal axis, labeled "Categories," displays eight distinct categories: Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, Science, and an additional category represented by a grey bar. The bars for Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, and Science are colored red, while the final category is represented by a grey bar. The tallest bar corresponds to the "News" category, with a value of 902 thousand sentences. The "Administrative" category follows with 525 thousand sentences. The "Non-fiction" category has 190 thousand sentences, "Science" has 110 thousand, "Religion" has 50 thousand, "Fiction" has 35 thousand, "Law" has 23 thousand, and the final category has 2 thousand sentences. The bars are arranged in descending order of sentence count from left to right, with the exception of the final grey bar, which is placed at the end.
